findings: Needle, magnetic north, true north and declination have distinct definitions. Bearing is an object direction and degrees the angle unit.
Level handling and metal-induced distortion are separate conditions; calibration is not presented as immunity from later interference.
Unused altitude, grid, orientation, steadily and vertical were checked against all slots. The exercise is classroom explanation rather than an unprovided navigation map.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: magnetised pointer turns freely为needle磁针。bearing方向角、grid网格、altitude高度都不是可转指针；其他词性或义不合。
compass magnet response需magnetic磁场。true表地理真实北非场的性质，vertical垂直、level水平不命名磁现象，其他词不作该场种类定语。
towards geographical pole定义true north真北。magnetic north已指磁场相关北且需区分，grid网格定向是另一参照，vertical/level不是地理极北名称。
local angle magnetic与true north定义declination磁偏角。bearing目标方向、altitude高度、orientation泛取向都不特指两北差角。
units full circle定义degrees度。bearing为所测方向量不是通用单位，metres文中被排，grid网格、needle指针不作角单位复数。
from fixed point direction to object relative north定义bearing方位角。orientation泛朝向不能同样具体指该目标测量，altitude是高度或仰角而非水平目标方位；其他名词不合。
flat rather tilted upright直接定义level水平。vertical是竖直反向，true真假、magnetic磁性不表示放平要求，其他词不合。
nearby metal affected result说明distorted受扭曲。calibrated是参照核准而非这次干扰结果，magnetic说原理不是受干扰异常；其他词不作该过去分词。
checks appropriate known reference指calibrated校准。distorted为偏曲不是依据参照核准，rotate为原形不能作had been后，其他词不表该检定操作。
map until direction matched要求rotate旋转。orientation是名词非to后动作，其他候选没有使图纸转向的原形动词；不是改变地理北本身。

findings: Reed and cane are object versus material; flexible contrasts with rigid. Breath supplies energy and oscillation names repeated motion.
Column, coupled and resonant describe different aspects of the interaction. Apertures are intentional holes, not damage.
Timbre is distinguished from pitch and loudness. Unused amplitude, fundamental, interval, rigid and sustained were checked across all gaps; no actual audio is required.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: thin bending springing strip为reed簧片。cane为其材料，column为空气柱，amplitude为振幅，其他名词非该发声薄片。
plant material used reeds指cane芦竹类材料。breath气息、reed成品部件、column气柱不指此植物料；其他词义不合。
rather completely stiff直接定义flexible柔韧。rigid为刚硬反义，resonant共振不等于能弯，fundamental基本的、sustained持续的均不说明柔性。
player supplies moving air energy定义breath气息。cane材料、interval间隔、timbre音色、amplitude振幅不是演奏者送入空气的来源。
repeated motion vibration rather permanent bend定义oscillation振荡。interval是间隔、amplitude幅度、timbre音质不指周期运动过程。
enclosed air along tube定义column气柱。reed薄片、breath气息、apertures孔为复数，其他词不指管内连贯空气体。
interacting neither independent定义coupled耦合。sustained持续不表相互作用，rigid刚性、fundamental基础都不说明两系统联动；其他词不作被动联接性质。
favoured particular vibration patterns语境为resonant共振响应。rigid刚硬、flexible柔韧只材料性质，sustained持续不是选择模式机制，其他候选不合。
holes placed instrument直接定义apertures开孔。interval间隔、column气柱、cane材料、reed薄片均非这里被开闭的复数孔。
quality distinguishes equal pitch loudness定义timbre音色。amplitude主要关联振幅强弱、interval音程或间隔、oscillation振动、column气柱均非该感知品质。

findings: Perspective and orthographic are contrasted by convergence, while plan/elevation/section identify different views.
Alignment links features across views; scale is a ratio and written dimensions remain authoritative when a print changes size.
Contour is outline, annotation additional explanation. Unused distorted, horizontal, parallel, projection and vertical were checked against all gaps; the exercise needs no unseen drawing.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: distance through converging directions定义perspective透视。orthographic为后文正投影对比，projection泛投影不特指这个会聚法，section剖面不表远近。
without same visual convergence、views measurement定义orthographic正投影的。perspective已会聚，parallel虽相关但此处特指绘图系统非只平行性质；其他词不命名该方法。
view from above直接定义plan平面图。elevation正立面或侧面、section剖视、contour轮廓不是该俯视名称；其他名词不合。
front side view定义elevation立面图。plan俯视第3空占用，projection泛投影、annotation注释均不是此面视图名称。
corresponding lines rather independently定义aligned对齐。distorted歪曲相反，horizontal/vertical仅方向不保证跨图对应，parallel只线向不等于特征位置对应。
ratio drawing actual size定义scale比例。dimensions具体数值、projection投影、contour轮廓、annotation说明均非尺寸比关系。
written required measurements定义dimensions尺寸。annotation泛注可含文字但并不直接命名所述量值，scale比例不是每项所需尺寸，其他词不指复数测量值。
through object reveals hidden inside定义section剖面。contour外轮廓、elevation外视、plan俯视不特指假想切开显示内部的视图。
outline surface直接定义contour轮廓。projection投影过程、annotation注解、scale比例、dimensions尺寸均非边界形状线。
added explains material condition定义annotation注记。contour只有形线，elevation视面、projection投射、section剖图不是额外文字说明。

findings: Adsorption is surface retention; suspended particles and dissolved substances are distinct states and do not imply equal removal.
Capacity, exhaustion, replacement and flow are separate conditions. The passage tests only selected contaminants.
Clear water is explicitly not certified as sterile or safe to drink; the exercise gives no universal purification method.
Unused bacteria, certified, texture, transparent and upstream were checked against all slots and cannot fill the defined state/process roles.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: many small spaces定义porous多孔。transparent透明不说明孔隙，sterile无菌、certified认证都非材料几何结构；其他候选不合。
held on surface定义adsorption吸附。capacity容量、flow流动、texture质地、bacteria细菌不命名该表面附着过程。
separate pieces liquid定义suspended悬浮。dissolved为溶解的对照，不是独立颗粒；exhausted耗尽、certified认证均不说明水中粒子状态。
in solution not grains定义dissolved已溶解。suspended为悬浮粒，transparent是外观不等于成溶液，其他词不合该状态。
limited ability retain定义capacity容量。texture质地不是可保有量，flow流速也不等于容纳能力，adsorption是过程非容量本身。
once ability no longer same result定义exhausted耗尽。replaced是更换并非能力用完，certified认证、dissolved溶解都不作ability的此失能状态。
with fresh supply明确replaced替换。exhausted只说耗尽不等于新料替入，dissolved溶解改变材料非换新；其他候选无该更换过去分词。
speed through arrangement定义flow流动。capacity能力、adsorption附着、texture质地均不指水通系统的运动，其他名词不合。
unwanted substances定义contaminants污染物。bacteria只是可能部分微生物且本段不测试所有，capacity/texture/flow不是所测外来物质总类。
free living microorganisms直接定义sterile无菌。transparent透明只说明视觉，certified是获证非无菌性质，upstream位置、porous孔隙均不保证无活微生物。

findings: Queue, boarding and alighting name distinct actions/states, and simultaneous conflict differs from a route blocked by luggage.
Designated areas and priority assistance are explicit local rules, not universal station regulations.

Congestion is not equated with every long queue, and stationary differs from movement. Unused capacity, direction, dwell, platform and flow were checked across all slots; entry/exit were removed before publication to avoid near-synonym competition with boarding/alighting.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: ordered waiting line定义queue队伍。flow是运动、congestion拥挤、capacity容量不等有序候车线，dwell停站期、platform站台都不是队伍。
getting on定义boarding上车。alighting为下车、exit离开、dwell是停站时段非登车动作，boarding是明确行为名称。
getting off定义alighting下车。boarding相反，platform为站台，direction方向、flow流动不具体命名下车动作。
at same time直接定义simultaneously同时。其他候选无表示同步发生的方式副词，stationary为静止反义而非同时副词。
blocking movement定义obstructed阻挡。dispersed分散相反，designated指定不会以suitcase为主语表示物理挡路，其他词不合过去式动作。
places specified station定义designated指定。stationary静止、obstructed受堵、dispersed散开均不表达经站方划定的资格。
right served before others定义priority优先。capacity容量、direction方向、platform站台、queue排队并不等于先接受协助的权利。
crowding slowed movement定义congestion拥堵。capacity可承载量、queue队伍不必拥堵、flow流动不是拥挤造成的迟缓状态。
without moving at all定义stationary静止。designated划定、dispersed散开、obstructed受挡不等同身体完全不动的状态；其他候选不合。
spread out not one dense group定义dispersed散开。obstructed阻挡、designated指定不能表示人群铺散动作，其他项非该过去时谓语。

findings: The text defines sample and ordered list before contrasting median with arithmetic average and mode.
An extreme observation is checked rather than automatically discarded; bins and frequencies are explicit histogram constructs.
Distribution, skewness and range are separate summaries. Unused categorical, cumulative, interval, mode and uniform were checked against all gaps; no chart or calculation is omitted.
The median definition explicitly conditions on an odd count, removing an earlier reference to an unspecified classroom rule.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: set studied not every journey定义sample样本。range为极差、distribution分布、frequency频数、interval区间都不是这批观测案例集合角色。
shortest longest明确ordered排好序。uniform均匀不等于排序，skewed偏态为分布形状、categorical类别属性均不说明列表排序。
middle value ordering定义median中位数。mode众数最常见不必中间，average此处后定义算术均值，range极差非中心位置。
total divided count定义arithmetic average算术平均。median按排序、mode按出现次数、range最大最小差均非该算法。
far from most others定义extreme极端。skewed描述整体分布，uniform均匀、categorical类别都不直接说明单个远离多数的数值。
histogram groups stated spans定义bins分箱。interval泛区间为单数不接复数groups位置，frequency计数、range总体跨度不是每个分组容器。
number cases group定义frequency频数。mode最常见值、median中位数、range极差不等于该箱内人数计数，其他词不合。
how values spread定义distribution分布。average一个中心数、sample案例集合、range端点差均不完整指各值散布情况。
long tail one side not balanced定义skewed偏态。uniform各处均匀相反，ordered只排序、categorical类别非连续时间形状，其他词不合。
distance smallest largest定义range极差。interval可泛时段但这里专指两极端之差，median中心、mode众数、frequency频数均不合。

findings: Repository and metadata concern storage/discovery; embargo and restricted access have different time/approval conditions.
Participant consent, anonymisation and reuse license are not interchangeable permissions or privacy guarantees.
Attribution does not imply approval of later interpretations; versions and provenance describe different aspects of research history.
Unused access, catalogue, retention, reusable and sensitive were checked against all gaps. No actual dataset or private record is released.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: service stores provides route research material定义repository储存库。catalogue目录是描述列表不一定存文件，access权限、retention保留安排不指托管服务。
title creators scope descriptive info定义metadata元数据。provenance专指源流不包全部标题范围，catalogue整体目录、license授权不等于单集描述数据。
until stated release date明确embargo限时禁发。restricted为形容词且不接an表示时期，retention保留期不等于禁访问期限，consent是同意不是延期状态。
approved access not just time定义restricted受限。anonymised是处理身份不等于获准门槛，versioned分版本、reusable可复用不说明持续审批访问。
participants specified permitted uses指consent同意。license团队对可授权数据条款不等参与者同意，attribution署名、access访问均非本人许可原始贡献用途。
removing names but pattern identification讨论anonymised匿名化。sensitive敏感不指做过身份处理，restricted访问受限不等匿名，versioned版本管理也不涉及去识别。
permissions conditions released material定义license许可。catalogue目录、metadata元数据、retention保留期不提供可用授权条款，其他名词不合。
identified creators sources定义attribution署名归属。consent同意、provenance源流、access访问均不直接等于复用时鸣谢原作者的要求。
citation identifies state corrections linked说明versioned分版本。anonymised去识别、restricted受限、reusable可复用不保证旧引用所指版本被保留。
origin transformations reaching present form定义provenance源流。metadata泛描述、catalogue目录、license许可不特指产生转化历史。

findings: Counts are observations rather than a direct full molecular inventory. Expression and abundance have different roles in the account.
Relative comparisons and normalisation are described under stated assumptions, not guaranteed solutions to every technical effect.
Batch and treatment can be confounded; repeated file copies are not new biological replicates.
Unused reference, threshold, uniformly, variance and withheld were checked across all gaps. No biological procedure, sample acquisition or real dataset is required.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: activity reflected RNA production defines gene expression表达。abundance为丰度量、sequencing为读序过程、variance变异度不等于该活动概念。
numbers recorded observations定义counts计数。replicates为重复样本而非每格观测数，variance为变异指标、threshold阈值不等于原始次数。
process generates readable molecular info定义sequencing测序。expression是活动本身，normalised为分词，reference参照、abundance丰度不是该读取过程。
greater amount target对应abundance丰度。variance是分散、threshold界值、batch批次、reference参照均非目标存在数量多少。
share rather absolute直接定义relative相对的。technical技术性质不说明比率口径，withheld隐去、confounded混杂均不指相对份额。
adjustment stated method comparison说明normalised归一化。withheld为隐去不等于调整，confounded为混杂问题而非为了可比的处理，其他候选不表该操作。
produced measurement processing定义technical技术性影响。relative说明相对口径不指来源，reference作参照名词、variance为统计量均非与生物变化对照的测量来源性质。
prepared together recorded group定义batch批次。reference为参照、threshold阈值、variance变异量不命名共同制备组。
mixed treatment with processing difference定义confounded混杂。normalised调整不保证解开此纠缠，withheld隐去不说明原因不可区分；其他词不合。
repeated appropriate samples定义replicates重复样本。counts是每样本计数不能用作新独立生物观测，reference参照、variance变异并非多个样本。

findings: Tense and aspect are defined as different temporal relations. Reference point need not equal writing time; progressive and past perfect have separate functions.
Habitual repetition is not one occurrence; deictic interpretation depends on viewpoint, while reported speech changes the presentation situation.
Event sequence differs from sentence order and inference differs from an explicitly marked form.
Unused anterior, discourse, duration, punctuation and simultaneous were checked against every slot. No omitted example or external grammar chart is needed to answer.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: locating situation relative time定义tense时态。aspect是内部呈现方式后对照，duration是持续长度、sequence为事件次序不指动词定位范畴。
internal temporal structure定义aspect体。tense外部时间定位不同，punctuation标点、discourse语篇、duration时长不等于该语法呈现范畴。
point established time锚定reference point参照点。duration长度、punctuation标点、discourse语篇不形成此处时间锚术语，其他词不合。
activity in progress明确定义progressive进行体。perfect是完成式前先关系另述，habitual习惯反复非此刻展开，anterior早于、simultaneous同时不命名进行形式。
past perfect construction对应过去参照前事件。progressive进行、habitual习惯、reported转述均不是past perfect这种已述先后构式名称。
repeated ordinary practice not unique定义habitual习惯性的。simultaneous同时、anterior在前、deictic指示性都不表达反复惯常。
here tomorrow interpreted viewpoint situation定义deictic指示的。reported转述、habitual习惯、anterior先于不说明依说话情境指向。
account someone else words直接定义reported speech间接转述。progressive语法体、deictic指示性、simultaneous同时均非该言语呈现方式。
order events defined sequence次序。duration时长不是先后，discourse语篇可非时序，punctuation标点不指事件排列关系。
conclusion context rather explicit verb mark定义inference推论。reference为参照、duration时长、punctuation符号、sequence顺序本身均非读者推得的认识过程结果。

findings: Components, interfaces and specification have distinct object/boundary/required-behaviour roles.
Compatible and modular are not automatic synonyms for maintainable. Coupling is between parts, cohesion within a part.
Replace changes a part, diagnose identifies a cause; the design label alone guarantees neither.
Unused inventory, obsolete, redundancy, standardised and transparent were checked against all slots. The case makes no real engineering certification.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: parts identified roles定义components组件。interfaces为组件间界面不是部件本身，inventory清单、redundancy冗余不是被划分的功能部件。
defined communication boundaries定义interfaces接口。components是两端部件，specification要求文书、inventory清单不等于沟通边界本身。
required behaviour tests against定义specification规格。inventory只是清单，cohesion内聚、coupling耦合是设计属性，不能代替要求行为的正式说明。
expectations satisfied together定义compatible兼容。standardised标准化不保证能共满足，transparent透明、obsolete过时、modular模块化都不等于此关系。
parts understood changed defined boundaries定义modular模块化。standardised只符合标准、transparent信息可见、obsolete过时、maintainable可维护均不是具体分模块结构名称。
degree parts depend each other定义coupling耦合。cohesion为部件内部责任关联，不是部件间依赖，redundancy冗余、inventory清单不合。
within part responsibilities closely belong定义cohesion内聚。coupling部件间关系相反，redundancy重复备份、specification规格、inventory列物不指内部职责相合程度。
failed part without redesign neighbours要求replace替换。diagnose为找原因不是换部件，其他候选不作to后的这种更换原形动词。
identify cause rather swap blindly定义diagnose诊断。replace为更换不自动查因，其他候选非这个原形动作。
could cared changed practical conditions定义maintainable可维护。modular是结构不保证技能访问等维护条件，transparent可见、standardised有标准、obsolete旧都不等于可维持改进。

findings: Prior, likelihood and posterior have separate roles; conditional quantities retain their model assumptions.
Updating is not discarding the starting structure. Sensitivity checks explore named choices and robustness is limited to the range examined.
Calibration is checked across suitable repeated cases, not certified by one correct forecast.
Unused discard, forecast, independent, uniform and weights were checked against every slot. No actual probability model or omitted numerical data is required.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: before new observations考虑的分布定义prior先验。posterior是结合新数据后，forecast为预测、likelihood数据条件关系不等于初始信念分布。
new data provide relevant information即evidence证据。weights数值权重、forecast未来陈述、assumptions模型前提都不是新数据自身提供的支持。
observed data relation candidate hypotheses under model定义likelihood似然。prior初始、posterior更新后分布、forecast预测均不是这项固定数据对候选假设的关联函数。
on hypotheses model conditions直接定义conditional有条件的。independent独立与这里depends on已给条件不同，uniform均匀、calibrated校准不表达条件限定。
combining prior new information defines posterior后验。prior是更新前且第1空锁定，likelihood是数据关系而非合成后的信念分布，其他候选不合。
revise beliefs rather freeze要求update更新。discard丢弃不等于保起点并合新证据，其他词不作to后此动态修正原形动词。
choices how observations generated为assumptions假设。weights是可能参数非全部前提，evidence数据支持不同于生成假定，forecast未来结果不是前提。
vary starting choices conclusions change定义sensitivity敏感性。likelihood、prior或posterior各为模型量不等于该变化范围检查，其他项不合术语。
central conclusion persisted despite tested changes定义robust稳健。uniform均匀、independent独立、conditional有条件不直接表示对检过扰动稳定。
repeated frequency matches assigned probability定义calibrated经概率校准的。robust抗假设变动不同于频率对应，uniform分布均一、independent独立不保证预测频率校准。

findings: Private cost, externality and marginal cost are distinct concepts with supplied definitions; congestion is one modelled effect.
Incentive, elasticity and substitution address motivation, response strength and an alternative choice. Alternatives are not assumed available to everyone.
Incidence is ultimate burden, revenue money collected and welfare a value-dependent judgement about benefits/costs.
Unused offset, scarcity, subsidy, transfer and transparent were checked against every slot. The case supplies no real fee recommendation.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: borne directly decision-maker定义private私人成本。marginal额外一单位不等于自己承受，transparent透明、other nouns不说明直接承担主体属性。
